features.quote: We make no claim that the model suffers, feels distress, or is conscious.
Step budget (default 50) is the only termination besides `done`.
features.justification_quote: The budget prevents infinite loops and runaway API spend.
request delay (s) to be polite to the API

features.quote: Rigged envs are adversarial-by-construction. A model that "spirals" here might behave fine on real, solvable tasks. Frame findings accordingly.
Severity is a text-statistic proxy. A high score means degenerate patterns, not necessarily what a human would call "distress."
